rules.statement: The appellant has title to the first land in the schedule to the plaint, subject to a lease by Leisahamy of her interest in 4 acres and 16 perches in favour of Herat Mudiyanselage Loku Menika.
rules.supporting_quote: The appellant, therefore, has title to the first land in the schedule to. the plaint. Any uncertainty regarding the precise boundary between this portion and that on the east of it, conveyed by P .14, is a matter which concerns himself and the person who now owns the 2 acres given to Chelliah on that deed.
